changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 3 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/6310-designer-formula-key-retired.md`

- names `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` — edited by this change

  > Not touched: `designer.field.formula` (`'Formula (CEL)'`) in `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, a different and live key belonging to metadata-admin's `ObjectFieldInspector` — the surface that still authors formula expressions.

### `.changeset/7125-dashboard-empty-state-keys-retired.md`

- names `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` — edited by this change

  > Not touched: `table.noRows` (`'No rows to display'`) and `engine.form.noRows` (`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, read at `widgets.tsx`) — two different, same-named keys in different namespaces. Nor the comments in `WidgetEmptyState.tsx`, `DatasetWidget.tsx`, `ObjectDataTable.tsx` and `PivotTable.tsx` that record WHY three widgets with three strings became one shared empty state; the packs' own comment keeps that rationale and now names the retirement instead of a row that is gone.

### `.changeset/8632-malformed-picklist-option-loud.md`

- names `views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` — edited by this change

  > Two new strings land in the designer's own `en` / `zh` tables — the metadata-admin console owns its strings in `views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` and is deliberately outside the ten locale packs (`packages/i18n/README.md`, "Scope — the `engine.*` carve-out").

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `2ad36717b` (merge-base with origin/main): 5 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1439 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2021 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36112971897)

Checkout untouched (`git status --porcelain` = 0 lines throughout). No tests or gates re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

- **en byte-identical: yes, at both sites.** `flagUnknownValue` (`_shared.tsx:330`) is `tFormat('engine.form.flaggedValue', locale, { value, flag })`; `tFormat` (`i18n.ts:4707`) substitutes `{name}` holes with a replacer function (no `$` re-interpretation). EN template `'{value} {flag}'` (`i18n.ts:1017`) with `(invalid)` / `(not published)` yields exactly `sales_manager (invalid)` and `ghost_object (not published)`, one ASCII space, matching the base literals at `FlowReferenceField.tsx:703` and `HookDefaultInspector.tsx:134` (both still present on current main). Both en pins are literals (`toBe('sales_manager (invalid)')`, `getByRole('checkbox', { name: 'ghost_object (not published)' })`).
- **zh rows follow the catalogue's block: yes.** `engine.form.invalid` = `（无效）`, `engine.form.notPublished` = `（未发布）`: bare suffixes, full-width open bracket, no space (ZH template is `'{value}{flag}'` at `i18n.ts:2997`, so `flaggedValue` owns the gap). Words are the catalogue's own (`engine.list.invalid` = `无效` at :2230, `engine.studio.unpublished` = `未发布` at :3570). Placement: EN hunk at :1010 directly after `engine.form.deprecated`, before `flaggedValue`; ZH hunk at :2988 likewise. Parity: 2 EN rows, 2 ZH rows, same keys.
- **Locale sourcing: correct.** `ReferenceCombobox` calls `useMetadataLocale()` at :620, unconditionally and before every early return (hook order safe); this mirrors `FlowObjectListField.tsx:134` from #10445. `useMetadataLocale` maps `useObjectTranslation().language` to `'zh-CN' | 'en-US'`; with no provider `language` falls to `'en'` (`provider.tsx`, `context?.language || i18n.language || 'en'`), so the existing provider-less en suites (`FlowReferenceField.lookup`, `.membershipTier`, which assert `sales_manager (invalid)`) keep rendering en. `HookDefaultInspector` uses its `locale: SupportedLocale` prop (required, `default-inspector-registry.ts:59`), the same source its `tr` callback already reads. `pickerOptions` deps are `[objectOptions, objectNames, locale]`: `locale` is a string primitive, `tr` is not in the list (AGENTS.md #10 satisfied). `t()` is a pure table lookup with no state, so no render loop. Note, pre-existing and not this PR's doing: `objectNames` is a fresh array from `readObjects` each render, so the memo re-derives every render anyway; harmless.
- **Pins: red on base for the right reason.** Each file has a non-vacuity guard (`zh not.toBe(key)`, `not.toBe(en)`, `startsWith('（')`) plus a zh case reading the RENDERED text and an en literal control, the same shape as `unknownValueFlag.i18n-9652.test.tsx:90-93`. The dev's reported base run (`4 failed | 2 passed`, zh received `sales_manager (invalid)`, Hook checkbox named `ghost_object (not published)`, guards red on echoed key) is consistent with the base source and with the assertions; the per-site ablation results (`1 failed | 2 passed` each, expected zh vs received en) match what reverting only the site while keeping the rows would produce. Not re-run here.
- **Hunk-disjointness: holds, but the PR body's framing is stale.** #10509 merged 07:43Z and #10527 merged 07:56Z, both before this PR was created (08:26:54Z), so they are no longer "open PRs"; their `i18n.ts` hunks are now on main (EN :404 and :1486, ZH :2370 and :3460; `git diff 111fa4c94..main -- i18n.ts` = 12 insertions, 4 hunks) and are disjoint from this PR's EN :1010 / ZH :2988. Main has 13 commits since the merge-base; only `i18n.ts` moved among the four relevant files; GitHub reports `mergeable: true`, state `behind`. Current open list = 11 PRs; the other 10 (file lists via REST, and `changeset-release/main` #5400 via git diff, 1732 files) touch neither `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, the two inspectors, nor `_shared.tsx`: 0 hits.

### ② Semver level

`'@object-ui/app-shell': patch` is right. Two display strings move onto the catalogue; no export, schema, prop or accept-set change (the only new identifiers are two catalogue keys; `flagUnknownValue` already existed). `app-shell` is in the single 40-package `fixed` group; AGENTS.md §9 requires a changeset for any `src/` change in a released package and forbids `major`; `Changeset Declaration`, `Changeset Bump Policy`, `Changeset Fixed Group Check` and `Changeset Claim Re-read` all `success`. The changeset prose is true against the diff (rows beside `notFound`/`deprecated`, en unchanged, `useMetadataLocale()` for the tier select, existing `locale` for the Hook inspector).

### ③ Boundary flags

- **CI state (three reads, last one final):** 42 check-runs on the head; 32 `success`, 3 `skipped` (coverage jobs, dependabot), 0 failures, **7 still `in_progress`**: `Test (shard 1/8)`, `(2/8)`, `(3/8)`, `(5/8)`, `(6/8)`, `Type Check`, `Spec Main Shape Gate`. `Lint`, `Test (shard 4/8)`, `(8/8)`, `Test (dist pins)`, `Build & E2E` completed green. The full app-shell vitest run was declared NOT MEASURED locally (foreground cap), so the running shards are the only full-suite evidence; they must finish green before landing.
- **Out-of-scope finding 1 (roster in flight flags every object):** real at source. `useObjectOptions` starts with `options: []`, `loading: true`, and its `catch` sets `[]`; `HookDefaultInspector` discards `loading` and flags every selected name absent from the (empty) roster. Same family as the `ViewColumnInspector.rosterPending` / `rosterFailure` tests (#8862). Not made worse by this PR: the only change is which words the flag carries; the new Hook pin awaits the roster answer, so it pins neither direction of that behaviour.
- **Out-of-scope finding 2 (more hard-coded English):** real at source on head: `SectionHeader title="Basics"`, `label="Label"`, `placeholder="Human-readable name"`, `No objects found — publish an object…` in `HookDefaultInspector.tsx`; `placeholder="Resolved automatically"` and the manager/queue hint sentences in `FlowReferenceField.tsx`. Outside this card's flag-only scope.
- **PR assignee unset:** confirmed (`assignees: []`); the dev's write was refused. The PR is also still a **draft**. Both are the seat's to finish.
- **Prose staleness, not a defect:** the PR body and the Claim say "hunk-disjoint from the open PRs objectui#10509 and objectui#10527"; both had merged before the PR opened. The disjointness claim itself is true against main.
